segments.card:
OFFICE OF THE COMMISSIONER

Correction & Clarification
Round 145
segments.say: A correction and clarification from the Office of the Commissioner. Round 145.

segments.card:
The theme required vocals in a
language other than English.

A question was raised in the group chat
on July 29th.
segments.say: The theme required vocals in a language other than English. A question was raised in the group chat on July twenty-ninth.

segments.card:
>>"Jb brought up an interesting question,
>>is tequila an English word"
segments.say: Quote: J B brought up an interesting question. Is tequila an English word.

segments.card: The Office has reviewed the matter.
segments.say: The Office has reviewed the matter.

segments.card:
“Tequila” is an English word.

It is also a Spanish word.

It is also a town in Jalisco.
segments.say: Tequila is an English word. It is also a Spanish word. It is also a town in Jalisco.

segments.card:
This clarification changes nothing.

The song took four downvotes
and finished on zero points.
segments.say: This clarification changes nothing. The song took four downvotes and finished on zero points.

segments.say: Quote: I did check with chat G T P on the origins of tequila. He said it is not English.

segments.card:
— and argued, at length,
by the man who submitted it.
